name: cast
title: The cast, before any of it appears
kicker: Names you'll hear · each one a pill
html:
The cast, before any of it appears

How agents call tools today: named functions, over JSON-RPC.

Our media type: the data and the acts its state allows now, in one answer.

The asynchronous half: ask now, be told later.

The generic client: to APIs what a browser is to web pages.

Our controls, on a laptop, in front of GitHub or GitLab.

One set of typed relations both forges answer to.

Three ways to deliver the same forms: all in one answer, or cached by link.

HEART behind six MCP tools that never change.
say: Before anything uses a name, here are the names. MCP is how agents call tools today: a list of named functions, called over JSON-RPC. HEART is our media type: every answer carries the data and the forms for the acts its state allows now. RISE is the asynchronous half: ask now, be told later. ARTIE is the generic client, coupled to HEART the way a browser is coupled to HTML. The gateway is a small server on a laptop that puts our controls in front of GitHub or GitLab. scm is the set of typed relations both forges answer to. L0, L1 and L2 are three ways to deliver the same forms, from all in one answer to cached by link. And heart-mcp is HEART behind six MCP tools that never change. Each is a pill; each comes back.
